nutrition_source_description: Bob's Red Mill TVP (Textured Vegetable Protein); Nutrition Facts serving size 1/4 cup (23g), 12g protein; ingredients: Defatted Soy Flour
nutrition_source_form: Dry textured defatted soy flour, as sold
nutrition_source_note: NOT A USDA RECORD. USDA FoodData Central publishes no textured vegetable protein entry, so this row is sourced to the manufacturer label of the exact priced product. The Bob's Red Mill product page was fetched 2026-08-02 and states serving size 1/4 cup (23g) with 12g protein, which is 52.17 g per 100 g. The previous 50.0 g per 100 g figure matched neither that label nor any USDA record and was unsupported; it has been corrected to 52.17 and protein_g_per_dollar recomputed from 22.5 to 23.4, which moves this row above canned kidney beans. The label rounds protein to the nearest gram, so the underlying value lies roughly between 50.0 and 54.3 g per 100 g. USDA's nearest analogue, Soy flour, defatted (FDC 174275) at 51.5 g per 100 g, corroborates the magnitude but is untextured flour and is not cited as this row's source.
